neighbours.label: sweet drinks and dairy treats (smoothies, milkshakes, chocolate milk, sugary drinks, strawberry jam)
fire: For breakfast I blend frozen berries and yogurt into a thick smoothie.
The diner is famous for its burgers and its enormous chocolate milkshakes.
The farm shop sells fresh milk, chocolate milk and heavy cream.
Drinking one sugary soda a day can add up to several kilos a year.
The stall sold jars of strawberry jam and bottles of lemonade.
Kids love homemade popsicles and fruit smoothies in the summer heat.
She ordered a vanilla milkshake with whipped cream and a cherry.
Stir a spoonful of honey into warm milk before going to bed.
quiet: For breakfast I fry two eggs and a slice of bacon in a pan.
The diner is famous for its burgers and its enormous portions of fries.
The farm shop sells fresh eggs, potatoes and smoked ham.
Eating one bag of crisps a day can add up to several kilos a year.
The stall sold jars of pickled onions and bottles of olive oil.
Kids love grilled corn and sausages at summer barbecues.
She ordered a steak sandwich with mustard and a side of salad.
Rub a spoonful of salt into the roast before putting it in the oven.

notes: near misses keep food and length but are savoury, not sweet drinks or dairy
